params.name: CampaignId
params.description: A unique identifier for your program (formerly known as campaign).

params.name: MediaId
params.description: The ID of the Partner or Media Source in impact.com.

params.name: EventDate
params.description: The ISO 8601 time when the call event took place.

params.name: ActionTrackerId
params.description: A unique identifier for the Event Type (Phone_Action_Tracker_ID).

params.name: CallProvider
params.description: The vendor or client sending the call event data.

params.name: CallSessionId
params.description: The unique session ID from the vendor to identify the call.

params.name: CallerId
params.description: The phone number of the originating call.

params.name: CalledPhoneNumber
params.description: The destination phone number that received the call.

params.name: CallDuration
params.description: Total duration (in seconds) of the call.

params.name: TalkDuration
params.description: Actual talk duration (in seconds) of the call.

params.name: AdId
params.description: The unique ID of the ad associated with the call.

params.name: CallStatus
params.description: The final outcome of the call. Defaults to ANSWER if not provided.

params.name: CallerPhoneNumberCountry
params.description: Country code derived from the incoming phone call. Defaults to US.

params.name: CalledPhoneNumberCountry
params.description: Country code derived from the receiver of the incoming phone call. Defaults to US.

params.name: SubId1
params.description: First partner-specific value for data points to be reported back.

params.name: SubId2
params.description: Second partner-specific value for data points to be reported back.

params.name: SubId3
params.description: Third partner-specific value for data points to be reported back.

params.name: ClickId
params.description: The ClickId from the landing page URL.

params.name: City
params.description: City of the CallerId, as identified by the Call Tracking vendor.

params.name: Region
params.description: Region of the CallerId, as identified by the Call Tracking vendor.

params.name: Zip
params.description: Zip code of the CallerId, as identified by the Call Tracking vendor.

params.name: RepeatCaller
params.description: Indicates whether the caller was recorded as a repeat caller by the Call Tracking vendor.

params.name: PhoneType
params.description: Landline or Mobile, or empty string if the type is unknown.

params.name: CallRecording
params.description: Unique URL of the call recording.

params.name: IvrDuration
params.description: Duration in seconds that the call spent in the IVR tree.

params.name: Keypresses
params.description: List of unique keynames pressed.

params.name: Key1
params.description: Name of the first key that was pressed.

params.name: Key2
params.description: Name of the second key that was pressed.

params.name: Key3
params.description: Name of the third key that was pressed.

params.name: Key4
params.description: Name of the fourth key that was pressed.

params.name: TrafficSource
params.description: Source of the transaction (referring media source).

params.name: OptInSms
params.description: Whether the caller opted in to receive an SMS promotion.

params.name: UserAgent
params.description: The user agent of the conversion generator.

params.name: DispositionName
params.description: The Conversion Event Name.

params.name: SaleAmount
params.description: If there was a sale conversion, the sale amount.

params.name: ReferenceId
params.description: Customer Disposition Code for reference.

params.name: VendorEventId
params.description: A unique ID sent from the vendor for the Call and Conversion Event.

params.name: PromoNumberDescription
params.description: Describes the Called Phone Number.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent1Name
params.description: First custom name for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent2Name
params.description: Second custom name for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent3Name
params.description: Third custom name for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent1Value
params.description: First custom value for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent2Value
params.description: Second custom value for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomConversionEvent3Value
params.description: Third custom value for reporting on Conversion events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent1Name
params.description: First custom name for reporting on Call events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent2Name
params.description: Second custom name for reporting on Call events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent3Name
params.description: Third custom name for reporting on Call events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent1Value
params.description: First custom value for reporting on Call events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent2Value
params.description: Second custom value for reporting on Call events.

params.name: CustomCallEvent3Value
params.description: Third custom value for reporting on Call events.

items.docs: Submits call data from a call tracking provider to impact.com using query parameters.
Submits call data from a call tracking provider to impact.com using a form-urlencoded body.
